en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of four photographs of the same small European town. Each view shows slightly different angles of central streets lined with 19th‑ and early‑20th‑century townhouses and shopfronts. Pedestrians walk on the sidewalks and a mix of cars from the 1960s–1970s and a boxy truck are parked or driving along cobbled streets. Shop signs in German advertise paints/varnish and electrical household and cooking appliances. Trees and low wooded hills appear in the background of some views.
